resources.string: Tor and Psiphon Chain add separate proxies to the selected tunnel. Psiphon Only runs without WARP. These choices are not extra WireGuard or Gool protocols. Leave them off unless you need them.
Device VPN protects apps on this device. Proxy mode lets you connect compatible apps individually.
Use Quick reconnect in Performance to recover automatically after temporary failures. Location never decides whether a connection is accepted.
Psiphon Chain Auto and Direct available. Psiphon Only: DNS bootstrap blocked. CDN: runtime tests failed.

Psiphon Chain routes Core through Psiphon. Auto and Direct transports verified via native tests (Sept 29). CDN blocked: 0/6 requests succeeded. Psiphon Only blocked: DNS bootstrap issue unresolved. Use Chain with Auto or Direct for working Psiphon functionality.
Tor SOCKS proxy available. Extended Tor features pending lifecycle validation.

Basic Tor SOCKS proxy (127.0.0.1:1821) is available. Extended features (relay sources, bridges, HTTP proxy) require additional lifecycle and traffic validation before activation. Some bridge transports connect outside the VPN tunnel.

Country restrictions can prevent WireGuard from opening its proxy because of a startup-order problem in the VPN core. Enforcement stays off. Without restrictions, any exit country, including Iran, remains acceptable.
Saved privacy options may be unavailable. Psiphon Chain Auto/Direct work. Psiphon Only/CDN, extended Tor and Exit Location remain blocked. Turn off blocked options before connecting.
Turn off blocked privacy features (Psiphon Only/CDN, extra Tor paths, Exit Location)? Working features (Psiphon Chain Auto/Direct, basic Tor) and your saved settings will be kept.
